definition: The modifier of an ability score (STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS, CHA): floor((score - 10) / 2), rounded toward negative infinity, never toward zero. A score of 18 gives +4, 10 and 11 give 0, 9 gives -1 (not 0: floor, not truncation) and 1 gives -5. The DM never types a modifier: it is always computed from the score, so a modifier is never stored apart from the score it comes from and every reader shows the same value. The score is an integer from 1 to 30; the Concept says nothing of a score outside that range.

modifier.rule: floor((score - 10) / 2); an even score gives (score - 10) / 2, an odd score gives (score - 11) / 2
